IC1: Has a HCC diagnosis confirmed by radiology [OR], histology [OR], or cytology (fibrolamellar, and [NOT] mixed hepatocellular/cholangiocarcinoma subtypes are [NOT]  not eligible)
IC2: Has Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer (BCLC) [AND] Stage C disease [OR] or BCLC [AND] Stage B disease not amenable to locoregional therapy [OR] or refractory to locoregional therapy [OR] and [NOT] not amenable to a curative treatment approach
IC3: Has a Child-Pugh A liver score within 7 days prior to first dose of study medication
IC4: Has a life expectancy of >3 months
IC5: Has at least one measurable lesion [AND] based on RECIST version 1.1 as determined by investigator
IC6: Has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 performed within 7 days prior to receiving the first dose of study medication
IC7: Has documented objective radiographic  progression during [OR] or after treatment with sorafenib or oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy, or else intolerance [AND] to sorafenib or oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy
IC8: Female participants of childbearing potential must have a negative urine [OR] or serum pregnancy test  within 72 hours prior to receiving the first dose of study therapy
IC9: Female [OR] and male participants of reproductive potential [AND] must agree to use adequate contraception starting from the first dose of study medication, throughout the study period, and for up to 120 days after the last dose of study medication
